word.purpose: The player's secret word on the three-line guide.

room-code.purpose: Read out loud from the game master's phone.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button press and hover only; off under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one next step on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 3rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.4rem; background: #1f4fa8; color: #fff; font: 700 1.125rem/1.5 Andika, 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #163c84; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f4fa8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 3rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; border: 2px solid #1f2429; border-radius: 0.4rem; background: transparent; color: #1f2429; font: 700 1.125rem/1.5 Andika, 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e6ebe7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f4fa8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Choice Line
components.description: A whole ruled line you can tap: a name to pick or vote for.
components.css: .ds-choice { min-height: 2.75rem; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 2px solid #6f93c8; border-radius: 0.4rem; background: #f3f5f2; color: #1f4fa8; font: 700 1.25rem/1.5 Andika, 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; } .ds-choice:hover { background: #1f4fa8; color: #fff; } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f4fa8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; font: 700 1.125rem/1.5 Andika, sans-serif; color: #1f2429; } .ds-input { min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 2px solid #46505a; border-radius: 0.4rem; background: #fff; font: 400 1.25rem/1.5 Andika, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f4fa8; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #1f4fa8; }

components.name: Spy Tag
components.description: Written SPY mark beside a name; game master and results only.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 2px solid #b3261e; border-radius: 0.4rem; color: #b3261e; font: 700 0.875rem/1.6 Andika, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Copybook Word
components.description: The player's word written on a three-line guide.
components.css: .ds-word { --g: 1.45em; margin: 0; font: 700 3.5rem/var(--g) Andika, sans-serif; color: #1f2429; background-image: linear-gradient(transparent 0.3em, #6f93c8 0.3em, #6f93c8 calc(0.3em + 1px), transparent calc(0.3em + 1px) 0.62em, #b7cbe4 0.62em, #b7cbe4 calc(0.62em + 1px), transparent calc(0.62em + 1px) 1.1em, #6f93c8 1.1em, #6f93c8 calc(1.1em + 2px), transparent calc(1.1em + 2px)); background-size: 100% var(--g); }

components.name: Pad Cover
components.description: Title band with the room code.
components.css: .ds-cover { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: #1f4fa8; color: #fff; border-bottom: 0.375rem solid #163c84; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Andika, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A cobalt pad cover over a newsprint page with blue writing rules and one red margin rule. Plain web controls; the world lends palette, type, density and the copybook word.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled rows at a 44px line pitch

rules.name: The Red Pen Rule
rules.body: Red marks only the spy and errors, always with a written word.

dos: Keep player screens identical for spy and non-spy
